info.name: Seat Reservation Service
info.description:
Walkthrough of the whole API with assertions. Run it with **Run collection** (Collection Runner) for a pass/fail result, or send the requests one by one.

**Set up**
1. Open this collection > **Variables**.
2. `baseUrl` is the live service (change it to `http://localhost:8080` for a local stack).
3. Paste the `ADMIN_TOKEN` you were given into `adminToken` (**Current value**; the initial value stays empty). Only requests 2.3 and 6.3 need it.

Each run uses a fresh `runId` for user ids and idempotency keys, so it can be repeated. The requests run one after another: this collection shows the API contract and the clean declines. The concurrency guarantees (exactly one winner per hot seat under 20,000 simultaneous requests, no 5xx, reconciliation) are shown by `./burst.sh <BASE_URL>` in the repository.
